Task Name: 11.7 Expand catalog with security & accessory products
Description: 12 new products added across three new categories - MFA & Security Keys (YubiKey 5 NFC, Titan Security Key, VeriMark), Cybersecurity (diskAshur PRO2, ClickSafe lock, Privacy Filter), USB Drives (SanDisk Extreme PRO, IronKey Keypad 200, DataTraveler Max) - plus Chargers (Apple/Anker/Dell) - bringing the catalog from 15 to 27 items.

A full static audit surfaced several severe defects introduced while the Phase 11 work was in flight - most critically, every page on the site had silently stopped using the shared layout. All are fixed and verified by static re-audit (no live build/test available in the audit environment - NuGet was network-blocked there).

Views/_ViewStart.cshtml (the file that applies _Layout.cshtml to every page) had gone missing and no view set Layout itself, so every page would have rendered as a bare unstyled fragment with no header, nav, or footer. Highest-severity finding of the audit; restored from a prior working copy.

wwwroot/images/ (all 27 product photos + 2 hero banners), jQuery, jQuery Validation, Bootstrap's JS bundle, and assistant.js had all gone missing from wwwroot/lib and wwwroot/js, breaking every product image, client-side form validation, dropdown/navbar JS, and the on-site assistant widget. All restored and version-matched.

Views/Shared/_ValidationScriptsPartial.cshtml (called by 11 forms including login/register/checkout - would have thrown at runtime) and Views/Shared/Error.cshtml (the production error-handler's own view) were both missing entirely. Restored.

Only CheckoutController validated anti-forgery tokens; login, register, cart, wishlist, contact, and every admin action accepted POSTs without checking the token the forms already sent. Fixed with one global AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter in Program.cs, with AssistantController.Ask (a same-origin JSON fetch) explicitly exempted.

The .git folder was a broken stub (a HEAD file with no objects/refs) rather than a real repository. Replaced with a proper git init and an initial commit; confirmed appsettings.json still stays untracked.

README.md updated to reflect the true 27-item catalog (was still stating 15), the new CI/CD and security additions, and the CSRF/rate-limiting posture; stale 'not yet a Git repository' line corrected.
